title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover the most productive environments across Carroll University, from quiet library carrels to collaborative science labs and rooftop patios.

cards.entity_name: Todd Wehr Memorial Library Reading Room
cards.title: The Second Floor Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Todd Wehr Memorial Library
cards.notes: Head to the second floor for traditional quiet study carrels and a focused atmosphere ideal for deep research and individual work.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet zone on the library's second floor featuring individual study carrels.
cards.evidence_claim: The library has both individual study spaces and areas for group work; for individual study, the best places are the Reading Room and study carrels on the 2nd floor.
cards.access_notes: Open during standard library hours; noise policy strictly enforced in this area.

cards.title: The Lower Level Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Todd Wehr Memorial Library
cards.notes: Access peer tutoring and supplemental instruction in this comfortable hub located in the library's lower level.
cards.short_summary: A campus hub for academic support services and collaborative study located in the library basement.
cards.evidence_claim: The Learning Commons (LC) is located in the lower level of the Todd Wehr Memorial Library and offers free academic support services.
cards.access_notes: Study space is open whenever the library building is open.

cards.title: Main Floor Information Commons
cards.subtitle: Todd Wehr Memorial Library
cards.notes: Utilize collaborative computer workstations and printing services in this high-traffic main floor area.
cards.short_summary: A technology-rich collaborative space on the library's main floor with shared computer workstations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Information Commons on the main floor has several collaborative computer workstations for groups that need to share a computer.
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; includes access to scanners and printers.

cards.title: Library Coffee Shop Lounge
cards.subtitle: Todd Wehr Memorial Library
cards.notes: Grab a drink and find a seat in this social study area on the library's main floor, perfect for casual group work.
cards.short_summary: A social study space located within the library featuring an on-site coffee shop.
cards.evidence_claim: The library has a Coffee Shop on the main floor where anyone can purchase food/drink in Stone Creek Coffee.
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks are permitted in this specific library zone.

cards.title: The Green Roof Patio
cards.subtitle: Doug and Nancy Hastad Hall
cards.notes: Study outdoors with a view of campus on this sustainable rooftop patio featuring Waukesha's first green roof.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor rooftop study space atop the LEED-certified Hastad Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Hastad Hall features a green roof and a rooftop patio which offers a space to host an event while admiring the campus below.
cards.source_title: Hastad Hall sets sustainability standard - Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; subject to weather conditions.

cards.title: The DEI Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Kilgour Hall
cards.notes: Find a cozy spot with couches and tables in this inclusive lounge located on the first floor of Kilgour Hall.
cards.short_summary: A welcoming student lounge area within the Office of Diversity, Equity and Inclusion.
cards.evidence_claim: The Office of Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in Kilgour Hall offers an open and cozy student lounge area with couches and tables.
cards.source_title: Diversity, Equity and Inclusion support expands presence - Carroll University
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor; includes microwave and fridge access for students.

cards.title: Jaharis Collaboration Spaces
cards.subtitle: Michael and Mary Jaharis Science Laboratories
cards.notes: Work on group projects in modern, glass-walled collaboration zones throughout this $24 million science facility.
cards.short_summary: Modern collaborative study areas integrated into the university's premier science building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Michael and Mary Jaharis Science Laboratories provide academic spaces and collaboration spaces for students.
cards.access_notes: Primarily used by science majors but open for general academic use during building hours.

cards.title: The Center of Everything
cards.subtitle: Campus Center
cards.notes: Study in the heart of campus activity with easy access to dining, the bookstore, and student organization offices.
cards.short_summary: A central, high-energy study and social area in the main student union building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Campus Center is a place to study, hang out, and access resources; it is described as the 'Center of Everything'.
cards.access_notes: Open late: Mon-Thu until 11:30 PM, Fri-Sat until 12:30 AM.

cards.title: Frontier Hall Study Lounges
cards.subtitle: Frontier Hall
cards.notes: Residents can utilize oversized common area kitchens and study lounges on each floor of this suite-style hall.
cards.short_summary: Floor-specific study lounges and common areas within Frontier Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Frontier Hall features common areas and study lounges, including an oversized common area kitchen on each floor.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to residents for upper floors; ground floor retail areas are public.

cards.title: The Sensory Study Room
cards.subtitle: Todd Wehr Memorial Library
cards.notes: Reserve this specialized room designed for neurodiverse students, providing a controlled environment for focused study.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library study room designed to meet sensory processing needs.
cards.evidence_claim: Room 206 is a Sensory Study Room designed for neurodiverse students, though it is open to all.
cards.source_title: Space Availability - Library - Reserve a Room
cards.access_notes: Reservable online for up to 4 hours per day; located in the 2nd floor quiet area.
